name: LinkedIn
description: Read the authenticated member's own posts and their comments, publish posts to their personal feed or a Company Page they administer, and comment on a post.
intentHints: reply to the comments on my linkedin posts
put the link in the first comment
read how my linkedin posts are doing
_authNote: OAuth endpoints, scopes, client secret ref and the identity step are PLATFORM-OWNED — they live in the private clarity-api (integrations-v2/config/oauth-configs.ts), never in this public repo. This manifest only declares that LinkedIn uses oauth2 and which tools it provides.

providedTools.description: Fetch the authenticated member's OWN most recent N posts (not a home feed — LinkedIn exposes no feed read to standard apps). Pair with list_comments to see who engaged with them.

Publish a post to LinkedIn. Posts to the member's own feed by default; pass org_id to post as a Company Page the member administers (falls back to the personal feed if page posting isn't authorized). To publish a picture with the post, pass image_file_id: the id returned by make_image. To publish a CHART, bind `report.rows` to the structured data and the platform draws it as the post image; do not flatten a list into prose. Pass image_base64 only when you already hold the exact bytes (base64 PNG, no data: prefix). Describe whichever you use in image_alt.

Comment on a LinkedIn post. Use it for the FIRST COMMENT under a post you just published: a link in the post body suppresses that post's reach, so the link belongs in a comment. Pass the post_id create_post returned. Comments as the member by default; pass org_id to comment as the Company Page that authored the post (falls back to the member if page commenting isn't authorized).

Read the comments ON a post, so you can reply to the people who engaged with it. Pass a post_id from fetch_posts or create_post. Each comment carries id, text, author urn, created_at and parent_comment. Returns an empty list with a `reason` when the account can't read comments on that post rather than failing.
List the LinkedIn Company Pages the authenticated member administers (for a page picker). Returns [] if Company Page access isn't authorized.
